description: Multi-domain co-sim assert: PID firmware duty register AND Newton motor velocity must both settle. The hardest task — electronic + physical domain in one plan. Requires Renode + the motor_pid firmware ELF.
goal: Flash firmware/motor_pid/motor_pid.elf, wait for the control loop to settle, then verify the TIM1 CCR1 duty register is in range [600,1000] and the simulated motor velocity settles near 12 rad/s
